components.html: Craft should feel inevitable.Product Design Principle

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a neutral desk surface: calm paper tones, dark ink typography, and low-noise borders that frame content without competing with it. Project artifacts carry saturation and visual energy, while the site chrome stays quiet and deliberate. The system uses editorial pacing instead of product-dashboard density. Large display headlines establish narrative hierarchy, then compact labels and measured body text support fast scanning. Motion is purposeful and restrained, reserved for wayfinding and direct manipulation.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral palette with one graphite signal color.
Typography-first hierarchy with one family, tuned through weight and tracking.
Sparse lines and section breaks instead of heavy containers.
Content-led media treatment with minimal decorative effects.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep `signal` rare and intentional. If everything is accented, nothing is accented.

rules.name: The Role-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Primary section headings lead through a clear step in scale and space. Nested subsection headings remain compact and use Graphite Signal, staying close to their supporting copy. Build hierarchy with scale, weight, tone, and rhythm before adding another typeface.

rules.name: The Breathing-Room Rule
rules.body: Preserve generous vertical cadence; do not compress spacing to force density.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces stay flat. State changes use subtle transform and color shifts instead of default shadows.

dos: Do keep chrome quiet and let project artifacts carry color energy.
Do use `signal` for wayfinding and actionable emphasis only.
Do maintain generous vertical spacing bands with line-based section breaks.
Do preserve readable text rhythm through tokenized caption/body/label roles.
donts: Don't introduce additional accent hues without an explicit identity shift.
Don't rely on heavy shadows, thick rails, or glossy gradients as default language.
Don't tilt documentary imagery; keep photos and figure media level unless rotation communicates data.
Don't animate layout properties (`width`, `height`, `padding`, `margin`) for routine UI state changes.
